    ∃ d, eval α (hasseDeriv d P) ≠ 0 ∧ weight r d = index P α r := by

    (show (weight r '' ((taylor α P).support : Set (σ →₀ ℕ))).Nonempty by
      simpa using hP).csInf_mem ((taylor α P).support.finite_toSet.image (weight r))

name: Roth.index_eq_weightedOrder_div
source:
theorem index_eq_weightedOrder_div {P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ} (hP : P ≠ 0) {r : σ → ℕ}
    (hr : ∀ j, 0 < r j) (α : σ → ℝ) : index P α r =
      (((taylor α P : MvPowerSeries σ ℝ).weightedOrder fun j ↦ (∏ i, r i) / r j).toNat : ℝ) /
        ∏ i, r i := by
  set w : σ → ℕ := fun j ↦ (∏ i, r i) / r j
  set F : MvPowerSeries σ ℝ := ↑(taylor α P)
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hdw⟩ := MvPowerSeries.exists_coeff_ne_zero_and_weightedOrder w (f := F)
    ((MvPowerSeries.ne_zero_iff_weightedOrder_finite w).1 (by simpa [F] using hP))
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [← hdw, ENat.toNat_natCast, ← weight_eq_finsuppWeight_div hr]
    exact index_le_weight (by simpa [F, MvPolynomial.coeff_coe, coeff_taylor] using hd)
  · refine (le_index_iff hP).2 fun e he ↦ ?_
    rw [weight_eq_finsuppWeight_div hr]
    refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    exact_mod_cast ENat.toNat_le_toNat (MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_le w (f := F) (d := e)
      (by simpa [F, MvPolynomial.coeff_coe, coeff_taylor] using he)) (by simp)

name: Roth.index_mul
source:
theorem index_mul {P Q : MvPolynomial σ ℝ} (hP : P ≠ 0) (hQ : Q ≠ 0) (α : σ → ℝ) {r : σ → ℕ}
    (hr : ∀ j, 0 < r j) : index (P * Q) α r = index P α r + index Q α r := by
  rw [index_eq_weightedOrder_div hP hr, index_eq_weightedOrder_div hQ hr,
    index_eq_weightedOrder_div (mul_ne_zero hP hQ) hr, ← add_div, map_mul, MvPolynomial.coe_mul,
    MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_mul]
  congr 1
  have hfin : ∀ R : MvPolynomial σ ℝ, R ≠ 0 →
      ((taylor α R : MvPowerSeries σ ℝ).weightedOrder fun j ↦ (∏ i, r i) / r j) ≠ ⊤ := by simp
  rw [ENat.toNat_add (hfin P hP) (hfin Q hQ), Nat.cast_add]

name: Roth.index_mul_left_weights
source:
theorem index_mul_left_weights {l : ℕ} (P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ) (α : σ → ℝ) (r : σ → ℕ) :
    index P α (fun j ↦ l * r j) = index P α r / l := by
  have himg : weight (fun j ↦ l * r j) '' ((taylor α P).support : Set (σ →₀ ℕ)) =
      (l : ℝ)⁻¹ • (weight r '' ((taylor α P).support : Set (σ →₀ ℕ))) := by
    rw [← Set.image_smul, Set.image_image]
    refine Set.image_congr fun d _ ↦ ?_
    rw [weight_mul_left, smul_eq_mul, div_eq_inv_mul]
  rw [index, index, himg, Real.sInf_smul_of_nonneg (by positivity), smul_eq_mul, div_eq_inv_mul]

name: MvPolynomial.coeff_taylor_monomial_single_add_aux
source:
private lemma coeff_taylor_monomial_single_add_aux (α : σ → R) (a : R) {i : σ} (n : ℕ) {k : σ →₀ ℕ}
    (hi : k i = 0)
    (ih : ∀ d, (taylor α (monomial k a)).coeff d = eval α (hasseDeriv d (monomial k a)))
    (d : σ →₀ ℕ) : (taylor α (monomial (Finsupp.single i n + k) a)).coeff d =
      eval α (hasseDeriv d (monomial (Finsupp.single i n + k) a)) := by
  have hXC : (X i + C (α i) : MvPolynomial σ R) ^ n =
      Polynomial.aeval (X i) ((Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C (α i)) ^ n) := by
    simp
  have hsupp : ∀ e ∈ (taylor α (monomial k a)).support, e i = 0 := by
    intro e he
    rw [mem_support_iff, ih e, hasseDeriv_monomial] at he
    by_contra h
    simp [(hasseCoeff_eq_zero_iff e k).2 fun hle ↦ h (le_zero_iff.1 (hi ▸ hle i))] at he
  rw [monomial_single_add, map_mul, map_pow, taylor_X, hXC,
    coeff_aeval_X_mul i _ _ hsupp, ih, Polynomial.coeff_X_add_C_pow,
    ← monomial_single_add, hasseDeriv_monomial, hasseDeriv_monomial, eval_monomial,
    eval_monomial, hasseCoeff_single_add_eq hi, prod_pow_single_add_tsub α hi]
  simp [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]

name: MvPolynomial.coeff_taylor_monomial_aux
source:
private lemma coeff_taylor_monomial_aux (α : σ → R) (d k : σ →₀ ℕ) (a : R) :
    (taylor α (monomial k a)).coeff d = eval α (hasseDeriv d (monomial k a)) := by
  classical
  induction k using Finsupp.induction generalizing d with
  | zero =>
    obtain rfl | hd := eq_or_ne d 0
    · simp
    · simp [← C_apply, hasseDeriv_C hd, hd.symm]
  | single_add i n k hi _ ih =>
    exact coeff_taylor_monomial_single_add_aux α a n (Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hi) ih d

name: MvPolynomial.eq_sum_box_hasseDeriv
source:
theorem eq_sum_box_hasseDeriv [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (α : σ → A) (r : σ → ℕ)
    (P : MvPolynomial σ A) (hP : ∀ j, degreeOf j P ≤ r j) :
    P = ∑ d ∈ Roth.box r, C (eval α (hasseDeriv d P)) * ∏ j, (X j - C (α j)) ^ d j := by
  have h1 : taylor α P = ∑ d ∈ Roth.box r, monomial d (eval α (hasseDeriv d P)) := by
    ext e
    simp only [coeff_taylor, coeff_sum, coeff_monomial, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
    split_ifs with he
    · rfl
    · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, r j < e j := by
        simpa [Roth.mem_box] using he
      rw [hasseDeriv_eq_zero_of_degreeOf_lt ((hP j).trans_lt hj), map_zero]
  calc P = taylor (fun j ↦ -α j) (taylor α P) := (taylor_neg_taylor α P).symm
    _ = _ := by
      rw [h1, map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d _ ↦ ?_
      rw [taylor_monomial, Finsupp.prod_fintype _ _ fun _ ↦ pow_zero _]
      simp [sub_eq_add_neg]
